result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `codeanalyzer` module tests ran with no failures reported in the tail of the output. I didn't add a test for the new matches, and I haven't run the patterns against sample `.htm`, `.xml` or `build-gradle.js` files.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern had `html|html|xhtml`, which listed `html` twice. It is now `html|htm|xhtml`, so `.htm` pages are covered and `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **Generated JS and .NET XML docs:** the path patterns `.*/[.]js` and `.*/[.]xml` only matched a file literally named `.js` or `.xml`. They are now `.*[.]js` and `.*[.]xml`. Ordinary `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope because the content patterns (`// Generated by …` and `<doc>`) still have to match.
- **Gradle JS scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment. `.*[.]gradle` is unchanged.
